tasks.title: Full Stack React & Node.js Micro-Internship
tasks.description: Develop full-stack web applications with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL. Implement RESTful APIs, responsive interfaces, and automated unit tests.

tasks.title: Generative AI & LLM Evaluation Pipeline
tasks.description: Construct an evaluation harness for LLM prompts and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) with LangChain and Python. Benchmark vector search precision against curated ground truth sets.

tasks.title: Cloud Infrastructure & CI/CD Pipeline Automation
tasks.description: Build automated Docker container build and GitHub Actions deployment workflows. Configure AWS Terraform infrastructure and container monitoring.

tasks.title: Cross-Platform Mobile App with React Native

tasks.title: Data Engineering & Stream Analytics Pipeline
tasks.description: Design ETL data ingestion pipelines using Python, SQL, and PostgreSQL. Cleanse and transform multi-gigabyte datasets and construct operational dashboards.

tasks.title: Application Security & Vulnerability Auditing
tasks.description: Perform static and dynamic security auditing on web applications. Identify OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, review npm dependencies, and automate security checks.

tasks.title: Design System & Accessible Component Discovery
tasks.description: Create a unified visual design system in Figma, interactive prototypes, and accessible WCAG-compliant design components for web and mobile.

tasks.title: Payment Gateway & Donation Processing Micro-Internship
tasks.description: Build an escrow and donation management portal with Stripe API and webhooks. Handle payment failures, refunds, and financial reporting dashboards.
